constraints.name: cliente_contacto_cliente_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (cliente_id) REFERENCES cliente(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: cotizacion_solicitante_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (solicitante_id) REFERENCES cliente_contacto(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: chk_cotizacion_linea_producto_o_personalizado
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((es_personalizado = false) AND (producto_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((es_personalizado = true) AND (descripcion IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: cotizacion_linea_cotizacion_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (cotizacion_id) REFERENCES cotizacion(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
